K_meaning: K(n) = n^(-1/2) k(log n), n from 2 to 1023 at which cQ(n) is not 0

S.form: S = r_0 + r_gamma gamma + r_pi log pi + SUM_p r_p log p

budget.rule: each constant an equal share: digits floor(log10(2 N |r| / |S|)) + 1, the half-width 10^-digits

controls.name: the bank as composed read back: each K(n) against the computed
PLANTED: one K(n), its numerator moved by 1, read as a difference
